steps.content: [WhiteSands Market]
The WhiteSands market is as bustling as ever. Vendors loudly advertise their wares to the endless flow of travelers.
Suddenly, people halt their steps and gather under a wooden board. Everyone whispers, curiously looking at the girl beside the bulletin board.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't miss this! Come and take a look!
A new batch of wanted posters cover the wall.
The fierce images of the desert bandits are gone. In their place are the silly portraits of the Tuco folks, with bounties stamped on their faces.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: WhiteSands' vilest, most disgusting scam is revealed! The evil scammers who ought to win acting awards! Beware of their tearjerker performances!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But they've messed with the wrong crowd! You've all heard of the MBCC, right? You've all heard of the legendary Chief, right?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoever can take me back to Tuco for revenge, I'll reward you with ${PlayerName}'s salary on behalf of the MBCC!
There are many onlookers, but most are just there for the spectacle.
A few half-believers step forward to talk to Hella, but soon shake their heads and leave. The spectators eventually think she's just seeking attention and leave as well.
A few hours past, but no one is willing to take the job.
However, Hella isn't sweating it. She leisurely packs up her little stool, muttering to herself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ah, looks like I didn't find any suitable recruits today. It's too hot and there are too few people at noon. Might as well go back and take a nap...
Pretending not to notice the shadow following her, Hella turns into an alley.
Then, the sack and club fall together.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mmph...!
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn, my head... hurts like hell...
After a while, her consciousness gradually returns.
The thwack to the back of her head hurt more than expected. Someone is speaking near her, but the voice is unclear, fading in and out.
Why isn't she waking up? Did you hit her too hard and crack her skull?
N-no way! I didn't use much force! I was even much gentler than usual...
Don't worry, she seems to be waking up now.
The voices become clearer. Light flickers before her eyes, and the darkness begins to fade...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is this... Tuco?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yeah, it's Tuco. The Tuco you dream of coming back to for "revenge"...
Several grinning faces suddenly pop into her view. Korryn and a group of Tuco folks squat around, looking down at her with smiles.
...Looking down?
An unusual feeling of restraint comes from all over her body. Hella stiffly lowers her head... only a flat ground is visible. There's no sign of her body.
She has been "planted" in the ground like a carrot!!!
Korryn holds up and waves a pile of their wanted posters.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: As you said: You'll reward whoever takes you back to Tuco and helps you get revenge.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I've completed half of it. As for the other half... how about we settle it after you transfer the Chief's salary to my account?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hell no! I'd rather toss that money in a ditch than give it to you, you bunch of deceitful, club-wielding scumbags!
The soil around her isn't packed. Hella suddenly frees a hand and punches Korryn in the face.
Revenge can come later. Right now, she just wants a brawl to vent her anger!
